notes: Part 2: BL21(DE3), C41(DE3), C43(DE3) each with empty pACYCDuet-1, induced with IPTG for 2 h after mid-log. BL21(DE3)EV+IPTG is the control (induced empty vector, parental strain). Sampled 2 h after induction: growth_phase left out. How C41/C43 differ from the parent is not described: genotype_class left out for them. No shaking or rRNA removal described.
